What was before we were born? What decided we will gain out of nothing a specific body and later consciousness at that time of our conception?
I think about this question a lot. Personally, I am not religious, but I can see why people would believe in a higher power.

Most of us really do not know. The scientific world has little to go on with regards to consciousness. There are some religions and spiritual traditions which do suggest various explanations.

One that is prominent is the notion that there is a sort of super-consciousness, a sentient being that all of reality is made manifest from in its own imagination, and that every thing in existence is merely a portion of that super-consciousness experiencing a reality from a subjective and dissociated perspective.

There are some variants of this too. The notion that consciousness does not enter into a being until it is of sufficient complexity neccesary to support a conscious experience. With humans, the period of around 4 months after initial conception during the gestation period in side the mother is when the nervous system is supposed to be sufficiently complex to support an experience of consciousness.

Some traditions believe that consciousness and thought do not even happen within the body or brain, but that the nervous system is sort of like a two-way radio that is in communication with who you actually are in some unseen realm. the notions of personality and identity are merely filters that exist in the particular arrangement of neurons in the brain.

Some people believe that personality itself is not something dictated by genetics, that it is a feature of a spirit or soul. They support this with the observation that genetically identical twin children can have dramatically different personalities despite being in the exact same environment.

Some people claim that they can experience an awareness of consciousness outside of their own bodies through rituals and practices like meditation and hypnosis, or through the use of psychoactive substances. In fact, there is a highly psychoactive substance inside every single person's brain called DMT, produced by the pineal gland - and that stuff has caused some of the most interesting experiences I've heard about.

Basically, we don't know yet. Some people think they know, but it isn't entirely clear. Some people are trying to figure it out, but it's really slow going since they don't really know how to begin to approach figuring it out.

What was before we were born?

I don't mean to be cheeky, but basically all of history. Additionally, when you die, time will continue to pass for the living (assuming others are still living).

Why would something need to make such a decision in order for you to exist?
